club.description: Bournville Village takes its character from Birmingham's historic garden village, with its tree-lined streets, green spaces and carefully planned neighbourhoods. The club reflects the area's tradition of community life and its distinctive identity within the wider city.

descriptions.de: Bournville Village ist vom historischen Gartenviertel Bournville in Birmingham geprägt, mit seinen baumbestandenen Straßen, Grünflächen und sorgfältig geplanten Wohngebieten. Der Verein spiegelt die Tradition des gemeinschaftlichen Lebens und die besondere Identität des Viertels innerhalb der Großstadt wider.
descriptions.es: Bournville Village se inspira en el histórico barrio jardín de Birmingham, con sus calles arboladas, espacios verdes y vecindarios cuidadosamente planificados. El club refleja la tradición de vida comunitaria de la zona y su identidad distintiva dentro de la ciudad.
descriptions.fr: Bournville Village puise son caractère dans l'ancienne cité-jardin de Birmingham, avec ses rues arborées, ses espaces verts et ses quartiers soigneusement aménagés. Le club reflète la tradition de vie collective du secteur et son identité particulière au sein de la ville.
descriptions.it: Bournville Village trae il proprio carattere dallo storico quartiere-giardino di Birmingham, con le sue strade alberate, gli spazi verdi e le aree residenziali attentamente pianificate. Il club riflette la tradizione di vita comunitaria del quartiere e la sua identità distintiva all'interno della città.
descriptions.en: Bournville Village takes its character from Birmingham's historic garden village, with its tree-lined streets, green spaces and carefully planned neighbourhoods. The club reflects the area's tradition of community life and its distinctive identity within the wider city.
